title: A Yes Person’s Guide to Saying No
summary: Defenses up I've always been an enthusiastic person. I like to jump from one project to the next (literally running, when possible) with my knobs turned to 11. I tend to do well on relatively short action cycles; getting started on (and being ready to move on from)
